decisions.reason: The MQL product line sits close to the core coolant and fluid-handling business and runs on modular platforms, so keeping it costs little while the demand for dry machining is still uncertain, and the missing website data gives no evidence that its value has failed.

The hydrocyclone filter builds on established filtration know-how and shares production and service infrastructure, so the option is cheap to hold, and there is no evidence yet that would justify abandoning it.

Gravity band filters are a standard, low-cost extension of the core coolant filtration offer that complements one-stop system delivery, so dropping it would release few resources while the option stays valuable.
